description: PLANNED (ADR-054, plan T21): Grant an instance of a definition the caller issued (POST /api/v1/grants with inventory.grant-request@1 → inventory.instance@1; Idempotency by idempotency_key). Outside the issuer's namespace: 403 inventory.not_issuer. Sold out: 409 inventory.supply_exhausted. Never for money (ADR-054 §5). It becomes active when OpenVibe.Inventory implements the route.
